prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving to outbound release. Elements/aliases: Inbound Inspection Desk=Cinderbay (checks paperwork, seals, damage; consumes Oversize Load Advisory; records proceed/rework/hold; sends Trailer Seal Exception Note to Yard Gate Controller; records governance approval, confirms config under change control). Pallet Dimension Scanner=Moonquarry (produces Oversize Load Advisory, not placement authorization). Inbound Pallet Buffer (staging only). North Aisle Stacker Crane=Juniperwake (sends Aisle Occupancy Snapshot to WMS; uses Slot Reservation Receipt; receives Crane Service Release Card as return-to-service authorization after checks; stops on obstruction). South Aisle Stacker Crane. East/West Transfer Conveyors (East restart: empty, reduced speed, one cycle first). Conveyor Line Controller=Brasshaven (sends Transfer Induction Ticket to Forklift Fleet; holds uncertain/duplicate transfers; closing: verifies zones clear). Autonomous Forklift Fleet=Larkspur (validates ticket destination; sends Forklift Handoff Confirmation to WMS, which closes movement record; parks in approved locations, reports restrictions). Yard Gate Controller=Velvetrook (validates arrivals, assigns doors). Outbound Dispatch Sorter (receives Dispatch Wave Amendment). Outbound Checkweigh Scale (sends Gross Weight Variance Slip to Shipping Documentation Desk, which reconciles vs shipment record before paperwork). Fire Alarm Panel (sends Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice to Safety Zone Controller; checked for faults/bypasses before release). Safety Zone Controller (exclusion boundary; both keep stop authority). Maintenance Release Terminal=Copperfield (issues Crane Service Release Card; records service, restrictions visible until cleared). Warehouse Management System=Morrowglass (authoritative; releases work, waves, Dispatch Wave Amendment, Slot Reservation Receipt; closes commissioning action register only when findings have owners/due dates). Actor: Warehouse Operations Supervisor (verifies personnel clear, reconciles holds, shift reviews, confirms acceptance evidence, reviews emergency changes); drivers, maintenance, spotter. Modes: crane available/fault/inhibited/recovery/unavailable; pallet held/rework/proceed; commissioning/routine. Requirements: seals before unloading; dimensional exceptions held; no work without WMS release; crane unavailable until functional/safety checks pass; scale variance out of tolerance resolved before release; handover records restrictions, incoming shift acknowledges before movements; commissioning per approved test plan, acceptance withheld on safety/inventory/shipment defects; changes need impact review, approval, implementation record.

New part:
S240: Operational performance and recurring faults are reviewed at a defined cadence using retained acceptance and maintenance records.
S241: The review assigns corrective actions with accountable owners, target dates, and evidence of closure.
S242: Training is updated when a change affects operator duties, alarm response, or equipment recovery procedures.
S243: The outgoing shift records remaining restrictions and unresolved concerns, and the incoming shift acknowledges them before authorizing routine movements.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
